dialogue.text: August 6, 1945. For the first time, a nuclear weapon is used in warfare.
dialogue.zh: 1945年8月6日。第一次在戰爭中使用核武器。
dialogue.ja: 1945年8月6日。戦争で初めて核兵器が使用されました。
dialogue.local: August 6, 1945. For the first time, a nuclear weapon is used in warfare.
dialogue.en: August 6, 1945. For the first time, a nuclear weapon is used in warfare.

dialogue.text: The United States drops an atomic bomb on Hiroshima Japan during World War II.
dialogue.zh: 美國在第二次世界大戰期間向日本廣島投下原子彈。
dialogue.ja: 第二次世界大戦中、アメリカは日本の広島に原子爆弾を投下しました。
dialogue.local: The United States drops an atomic bomb on Hiroshima Japan during World War II.
dialogue.en: The United States drops an atomic bomb on Hiroshima Japan during World War II.

dialogue.text: The blast in its aftermath killing estimated 140,000 people.
dialogue.zh: 爆炸及其後果估計造成14萬人死亡。
dialogue.ja: 爆発とその後の影響で約14万人が亡くなりました。
dialogue.local: The blast in its aftermath killing estimated 140,000 people.
dialogue.en: The blast in its aftermath killing estimated 140,000 people.

dialogue.ja: ハリー・トルーマン大統領の言葉です。

dialogue.text: "We have used it in order to shorten the agony of war, in order to save the lives of thousands and thousands of young Americans.
dialogue.zh: 「我們使用它是為了縮短戰爭的痛苦，為了拯救成千上萬年輕美國人的生命。
dialogue.ja: 「私たちは戦争の苦しみを短縮し、何千人もの若いアメリカ人の命を救うためにこれを使いました。
dialogue.local: "We have used it in order to shorten the agony of war, in order to save the lives of thousands and thousands of young Americans.
dialogue.en: "We have used it in order to shorten the agony of war, in order to save the lives of thousands and thousands of young Americans.

dialogue.text: We shall continue to use it until we completely destroy Japan's power to make war."
dialogue.zh: 我們將繼續使用它，直到徹底摧毀日本的戰爭能力。」
dialogue.ja: 私たちは日本の戦争能力を完全に破壊するまで使い続けます。」
dialogue.local: We shall continue to use it until we completely destroy Japan's power to make war."
dialogue.en: We shall continue to use it until we completely destroy Japan's power to make war."

dialogue.text: 1965. In Washington, a victory for America's civil rights movement, as President Lyndon Johnson signs the Voting Rights Act.
dialogue.zh: 1965年。在華盛頓，美國民權運動取得勝利，總統林登·約翰遜簽署了《投票權法案》。
dialogue.ja: 1965年。ワシントンで、アメリカの公民権運動の勝利として、リンドン・ジョンソン大統領が投票権法に署名しました。
dialogue.local: 1965. In Washington, a victory for America's civil rights movement, as President Lyndon Johnson signs the Voting Rights Act.
dialogue.en: 1965. In Washington, a victory for America's civil rights movement, as President Lyndon Johnson signs the Voting Rights Act.

dialogue.text: The law lifts barriers in segregated states of the South, aimed at preventing blacks from exercising their right to vote.
dialogue.zh: 該法律取消了南方種族隔離州阻止黑人行使投票權的障礙。
dialogue.ja: この法律は、南部の人種隔離州で黒人が投票権を行使するのを妨げる障壁を取り除きました。
dialogue.local: The law lifts barriers in segregated states of the South, aimed at preventing blacks from exercising their right to vote.
dialogue.en: The law lifts barriers in segregated states of the South, aimed at preventing blacks from exercising their right to vote.

dialogue.text: 1978. Pope Paul VI dies in Castlegendolfo, Italy, at age 80.
dialogue.zh: 1978年。教宗保祿六世於義大利卡斯特萊岡多爾夫去世，享年80歲。
dialogue.ja: 1978年。教皇パウロ6世がイタリアのカステルガンドルフォで80歳で亡くなりました。
dialogue.local: 1978. Pope Paul VI dies in Castlegendolfo, Italy, at age 80.
dialogue.en: 1978. Pope Paul VI dies in Castlegendolfo, Italy, at age 80.

dialogue.text: His successor, Pope John Paul I, dies after 33 days as pope.
dialogue.zh: 他的繼任者教宗若望保祿一世在擔任教宗33天後去世。
dialogue.ja: 後任の教皇ヨハネ・パウロ1世は、教皇として33日後に亡くなりました。
dialogue.local: His successor, Pope John Paul I, dies after 33 days as pope.
dialogue.en: His successor, Pope John Paul I, dies after 33 days as pope.

dialogue.text: He is followed by Pope John Paul II.
dialogue.zh: 隨後是教宗若望保祿二世。
dialogue.ja: その後、教皇ヨハネ・パウロ2世が続きました。
dialogue.local: He is followed by Pope John Paul II.
dialogue.en: He is followed by Pope John Paul II.

dialogue.text: 1881. Alexander Fleming, the scientist behind the discovery of the antibiotic agent Penicillin, is born in Lockfield, Scotland.
dialogue.zh: 1881年。發現抗生素青黴素的科學家亞歷山大·弗萊明出生於蘇格蘭洛克菲爾德。
dialogue.ja: 1881年。抗生物質ペニシリンを発見した科学者アレクサンダー・フレミングがスコットランドのロックフィールドで生まれました。
dialogue.local: 1881. Alexander Fleming, the scientist behind the discovery of the antibiotic agent Penicillin, is born in Lockfield, Scotland.
dialogue.en: 1881. Alexander Fleming, the scientist behind the discovery of the antibiotic agent Penicillin, is born in Lockfield, Scotland.

dialogue.text: Fung singer Rick James dies of a heart attack at his home in Los Angeles. He was 56-years-old.
dialogue.zh: 放克歌手瑞克·詹姆斯在洛杉磯家中因心臟病發作去世，享年56歲。
dialogue.ja: ファンク歌手のリック・ジェームズがロサンゼルスの自宅で心臓発作により亡くなりました。享年56歳でした。
dialogue.local: Fung singer Rick James dies of a heart attack at his home in Los Angeles. He was 56-years-old.
dialogue.en: Fung singer Rick James dies of a heart attack at his home in Los Angeles. He was 56-years-old.

dialogue.text: Today in history, August 6th, Sandy Cozell, the Associated Press.
dialogue.zh: 歷史上的今天，8月6日，美聯社的桑迪·科澤爾報導。
dialogue.ja: 今日は歴史上の8月6日、AP通信のサンディ・コゼルがお伝えします。
dialogue.local: Today in history, August 6th, Sandy Cozell, the Associated Press.
dialogue.en: Today in history, August 6th, Sandy Cozell, the Associated Press.
